text:
dylan: Quick follow-up on the modularization RFC — proposing a 3-phase pacing: carve, stabilize, paydown. TL;DR: do smaller vertical excises over 6 sprints, keep a compatibility shim for ~3 months. Thoughts?

emma: sounds reasonable. can you enumerate which services we cut in phase 1?

dylan: Phase 1 candidates: request-router, session-choreography, enrichment-adapter. low-risk, high-telemetry. Goal: land core extracts within sprint 2.

ben: +1 on candidates. one constraint: don’t touch hotpath in request-router until we have latency regression tests in CI.

carla: Agree. We'll need a rollout playbook. Suggest: feature-flagged canary + traffic mirror + explicit fallback path.

francis: Cost note: temporary duplication will spike egress + cache misses. rough infra bump estimate: +10–15% for ~8 weeks.

sara: Ops can absorb if we get an early alert on p95. I'll add tracing spans to the shim path and tag them with `modular.phase1`.

dylan: Draft playbook snippet:

`````
0) Create feature flag `modular_cut_phase1`
1) Deploy shim v2 that proxies to v1 by default
2) Enable 1% canary traffic -> monitor latency, error rate, kv cache missrate
3) If OK, increase to 10% over 3 days
4) If regressions, rollback flag -> alert SRE and pause rollout
`````

emma: metrics we care about: p50/p95/p99 latency, error %, kv-cache hit rate, CPU%, tokens/sec (throughput).

ben: also add rollout abort conditions: +5% p95, +3% error rate, cache miss +10ppt. Keep conservative.

carla: who owns the shim? My vote: runtime-team owns the shim code and operational runbook, enrichment-team owns extraction of adapter logic.

dylan: ownership: runtime-team builds shim and infra hooks; enrichment-team extracts adapter; infra/sre support rollout automation.

francis: idea for tracking tech-debt: measure duplicated lines as `debt_tokens` and decrement per merge. tie a simple metric to the OKR so teams prioritize cleanup.

sara: +1. I'll add dashboard panels: `modular_phase1/duplication_tokens`, `modular_phase1/latency_regressions`, `modular_phase1/canary_errors`.

deploy-bot: Deployment started for `shim-v2` -> canary job 12345 (watch: https://ci.redwood.example/job/12345)

emma: small UX ask: add header `x-modular-shim: phase1` on proxied requests so we can filter logs/traces easily.

dylan: good call — include header and a debug flag for sampling more traces from canary.

carla: we should schedule a 2-week spike to validate migration scripts and rollbacks; avoid doing large DB migrations inline with cut.

ben: +1. also adding latency regression tests to pipeline (PR incoming). will include token-length stress cases.

francis: proposed timeline: Phase 1 = 6 weeks (spike + rollout), Phase 2 = 8 weeks, paydown window months 4–6 for cleanup.

dylan: action items: @emma write rollout doc, @francis finalize cost estimate, @sara create dashboards, @carla schedule migration spike. I’ll update the RFC with the pacing and owners.

emma: ack :thumbsup:

sara: dashboard created, link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd/modular-phase1

carla: created spike ticket RDW-4210 and invited runtime & enrichment leads.

ben: PR opened for regression tests -> will tag ppl for review.

dylan: thanks all. closing for now — will collect notes in the RFC doc and ping if anything urgent comes up.
